question: In February 2023, BVR Subrahmanyam was appointed as the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**CEO NITI Aayog**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• BVR Subrahmanyam was appointed as the CEO of NITI Aayog in February 2023.
 
• He succeeded Parameswaran Iyer, who was appointed as the Executive Director of World Bank.
 
• NITI Aayog, or the National Institution for Transforming India, is the premier policy think tank of the Government of India.
 
• It aims to foster cooperative federalism and ensure that the states and the central government work together on key policy issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chief Vigilance Commissioner**

 
 
• The Chief Vigilance Commissioner (CVC) is the head of the Central Vigilance Commission.
 
• The CVC is appointed by the President of India to address governmental corruption.
 
• The position is pivotal for ensuring transparency and accountability in the public administration.
 
 
 
• **Comptroller General of India**
 
 
• The Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) is an authority established by the Constitution of India.
 
• The CAG audits all receipts and expenditure of the Government of India and the state governments, including those of bodies and authorities substantially financed by the government.
 
• The role of CAG is critical in maintaining the financial accountability of the government to the Parliament and the legislature.
 
 
 
• **Chief Election Commissioner**
 
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) heads the Election Commission of India.
 
• The CEC is responsible for administering election processes in India at both the national and state levels.
 
• This role ensures free and fair elections, which are fundamental to the democratic process.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**
 
 
• NITI Aayog stands for National Institution for Transforming India.
 
• It was established in 2015, replacing the Planning Commission of India.
 
• NITI Aayog is responsible for formulating policies and strategies for the economic development of the country.
 
• It acts as a catalyst for innovation and promotes cooperative federalism by involving state governments in the policy-making process.
